name: Brigade Gateway at Neopolis
config: 3 & 4 bed residences and 5 & 6 bed sky duplexes
description: Two 58-floor residential towers within a 9.7-acre integrated development at Neopolis, Kokapet, which also includes a World Trade Center office tower, an InterContinental hotel, and an Orion Mall. The residences are served by a 50,000 sq.ft clubhouse.
curation: Office, hotel, mall, and homes on one campus
Close to the Financial District and Gachibowli
connectivity: Just off the Outer Ring Road
Close to the Financial District and Gachibowli
Indus, Oakridge, and CHIREC schools nearby

developerNote: Founded in 1986, Brigade Group is a publicly listed company on the NSE and BSE. Its portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail, and hospitality developments, from apartments and integrated enclaves to offices, malls, hotels, and schools.
